lines.zh: 肚皮擦着沙，我跑得很快。
lines.en: Belly to the sand, I scurry fast.
Four short legs move quickly.
I slip between the stones.
A flick of my tail and I turn.
My tracks are small and close together.
I run along the riverbank.
I run best on sand.

lines.zh: 我停在草丛边上嗅了嗅
lines.en: I stop at the grass and sniff.
I crawl under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的靴子跑了一圈
lines.en: I run a circle around your boot.
I run a stretch, then stop and look.

lines.zh: 我挤过一条很窄的石缝
lines.en: I squeeze through a narrow crack.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下我的肚皮印
lines.en: My belly leaves marks in the mud.
I head for the insects by the water.

lines.zh: 我轻快地越过一根树枝
lines.en: I bound lightly over a branch.
I duck back under the stones.
I have paths everywhere here.
I run and forage as I go.
I lie on a warm stone.
I'm no bigger than a house cat.
I hold my head up, perfectly still.
I blink once, then freeze again.
My tail lies flat on the ground.
I'm waiting for an insect to come near.
The wind smells of water.
I open my mouth to the sun.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，晒另一边。
lines.en: I shift my pose to sun the other side.
It's cool under the stones.
I listen to the water a while.

lines.zh: 我趴得很低，几乎看不见
lines.en: I lie so low I'm nearly invisible.
I squint, entirely at ease.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁爬过我的爪子
lines.en: An ant crawls over my claws.
I don't move and let it pass.
This stone is my spot.
You're so big; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看一棵太高的树。
lines.en: I look up at you like a tree that's far too tall.
I'm not afraid, only careful.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的石头
lines.en: Your shadow has covered my stone.
One move, and you see me.
I retreat to the edge of the crack.
Try to catch me and I'll run.
I'm small, and easy to hide.
You crouch down, and I look up.
An arm's length is all there is.
Move a finger, and I pounce.
I've gone around to your other side.
I flip over and hide under a stone.
A bit of my tail is gone.
I lie still, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，一碰就伤
lines.en: A body this small bruises at a touch.
I hiss, faint and brief.
I squeeze into the crack.
Little blood, but much pain.
This little croc body props up on its forelegs.
I can still run.
Don't step on me again.
That twitch in the sand, a bug?
I poke my head out and sniff.
Something that small is just right.
Set it down and I'll go.
I creep closer, step by step.
I'm smaller than a house cat.

lines.zh: 虫子一挣扎，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: The bug struggles, and I bite harder.
This shell is too hard; I'll find another bug.
Got more?
I won't snatch. I'll wait.
Don't let your hand shake; it frightens me.
That's a small bite, not enough.
I chew and swallow.
This isn't what I usually eat.
Step back and I'll dare to eat.
After that I'll duck back under the stones.

lines.zh: 你的靴底擦过我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your boot sole brushes my tail.
I flash out from beside your foot.
I hit your boot and bounce off.
A body this small won't hurt you.
I roll over and right myself.

lines.zh: 我这小身板，从你靴缝里挤过去。
lines.en: This tiny body squeezes between your boots.
You step back, and then I move.
The crack is narrow; I catch for a moment.
I flick my tail. No harm.
Lucky for me, this time.
You're small too.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一块石头上
lines.en: We crowd onto the same stone.
I run, and you run.

lines.zh: 这块河滩够我们找吃的
lines.en: There's foraging enough on this bank.

lines.zh: 你留神天上，我留神地上
lines.en: You watch the sky; I'll watch the ground.
We slip under the stones together.
You go ahead; I'll bring up the rear.
Too noisy here. Follow me.
Let's sun ourselves a while.
Don't get separated.
I snap up the insect.
Too big. I can't drag it.
I balance it on my snout.
I pick up what falls.
I carry it back to the crack.

lines.zh: 这点不够塞牙，再来一块。
lines.en: Not enough to get stuck in my teeth — another piece.
This has no taste.

lines.zh: 我比家猫还小，却也是鳄类。
lines.en: Smaller than a cat, still a croc.
Two bites and I spit it out.
You dropped it. It's mine.
Something small moves in the grass.
I flatten myself down.
My eyes track it closely.
It's only two steps from me.
I keep still and let it come.
The wind is blowing my way.
My tail tip twitches.
It has stopped to groom itself.
I slide half a foot along the sand.
I pounce.
I keep very low.
My feet edge forward.
I'm smaller than a house cat — no need to fear.
My shadow is in the grass.
One palm's width more, and I freeze.
The stone hides my shape.
It turns, and I flatten even lower.
I circle to cut it off.
Its back is to the river now.
I'm no bigger than a house cat.
I snap at it.
My teeth are small but sharp.
I drag it a little.
My teeth are fine, but once I bite, I hold.
It shakes twice and gets free.
I lash at it with my tail.
That bite caught only air.
I shrink into the crack, eyes only.
It's far too big for me.
I duck back into the crack.
I crawl out of a stone crack.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的小鳄，晒得眯眼。
lines.en: A Triassic croc, squinting in the sun.
Grains of sand slide off my back.
I can see this riverbank clearly.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有一点点大
lines.en: My body is only a little thing.
I run three steps to start.
Insects are flying; I go after them.
Under the stones is safe.
I mark this spot.
Water sounds near; I head there.
My tail sweeps aside the pebbles.
A shadow above; I freeze.
Burned, I run for the water.

lines.zh: 从石头上掉下来，我翻了身
lines.en: I fall off the stone and tumble.
Too deep; I paddle desperately.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到石头那边
lines.en: The blast flings me against the stones.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺穿了我的尾巴
lines.en: Something sharp pierces my tail.
A flash freezes me in place.

lines.zh: 找不到虫子，我越来越弱
lines.en: No insects to be found; I weaken.
Thunder flattens me to the ground.
The stone is gone; I fall.
